name: neutral-atom-toolkit
description: Neutral Atom Toolkit — the QPU experiment pipeline: rough problem → technical idea → spec → Pulser sequence → EMU validation → noise emulation (local / SLURM / cloud) → submission to FRESNEL_CAN1 (Pasqal Cloud) or Ruby (CEA/TGCC) → harvest & analysis. Also includes access skills: create a Pasqal Cloud account, apply for CEA/GENCI/EuroHPC access, and a route-choice skill for deciding between them.
